bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to education; prohibiting certain material in school libraries; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 134.31, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 134.31, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 8.+]

[+Prohibited material.+]

[+A library in a public school building must not contain any pornographic material. A library in a public elementary school must not contain any sexually explicit content. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education; prohibiting certain material in school libraries; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 134.31, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 134.31, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 8.

Prohibited material.

A library in a public school building must not contain any pornographic material. A library in a public elementary school must not contain any sexually explicit content.
